mapper.select: -- 分页查询父回复 SELECT r.id, r.content, r.user_id AS userId, r.post_id AS postId, r.like_count AS likeCount, r.created_time AS createdTime, r.parent_id AS parentId, u.username, u.image FROM replies r INNER JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.post_id = #{postid} AND r.status = 0 AND r.parent_id = 0 ORDER BY r.like_count DESC, r.created_time DESC

mapper.insert: insert into replies(content, user_id, post_id, created_time,updated_time,parent_id) values (#{content}, #{userId}, #{postId}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedTime}, #{parentId})
mapper.update:
UPDATE replies
like_count = #{likeCount},
content = #{content},
status = #{status},
updated_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.content, r.created_time AS createdTime, r.post_id AS postId, p.title, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM replies WHERE post_id = p.id AND status = 0) AS replyCount, s.id AS sectionId, s.name AS sectionName FROM replies r INNER JOIN posts p ON r.post_id = p.id INNER JOIN sections s ON p.section_id = s.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 0 -- 只查询正常状态的回复 AND p.status = 0 -- 只查询正常状态的帖子 ORDER BY r.created_time DESC
